12. Equilibrium and Welfare

Find competitive equilibrium in the Edgeworth box and see Pareto efficiency and the two welfare theorems with your own eyes.

  • The Edgeworth Box and Competitive Equilibrium — Endowment, offer curves, and the contract curve inside the two-consumer box. At the equilibrium price p1p_1p1​ the budget line touches both indifference curves at once — that tangency is the competitive equilibrium. The thick segment is the core.
  • The Two Welfare Theorems — Walk along the utility possibility frontier. Competitive equilibrium (CE) sits on the frontier — the First Theorem. Pick another Pareto optimum with the slider and the supporting price plus the lump-sum transfer TTT that decentralizes it are computed — the Second Theorem.
